description: Send a message to the INITE team on behalf of a named person; the reply goes to their email. For a question that needs a conversation, inite_book_call is faster.

company.description: Their company or site, if they gave one

email.description: The person's own email; the reply goes there

lang.description: The reader's language; sets the currency (pt quotes reais) and the copy. Default en.

message.description: What they want to say or ask, in their words

service.description: Which service it is about, if any

name: inite_contact
title: Write to the INITE team
